verdict.rationale: Licensing and governance is a fair axis for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the pack has no first-party evidence of an open license or open, community-run governance. The only on-topic item, a community comment on 'the BUSL change', points to a relicensing that already happened, which is the opposite of the story's guarantee. That makes this 'none', not 'disputed', because the vendor never claims the capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on an open license and open governance so the tool cannot be relicensed out from under my company
